text:
tina (support): Hi team, customer Maria reports their daily usage CSV shows some rows split across two dates after our export. She says totals don't match the dashboard.

maria (customer): Hi, I pulled our export for 2025-09-03 and we have rows with timestamps 2025-09-02T23:58:00Z and 2025-09-03T00:02:00Z but our org timezone is America/Los_Angeles so those should both be 2025-09-02 local. totals mismatch ~2.7%.

alex (eng): @maria can you paste the csv header + a couple sample rows? do you see a timezone column or is it all UTC?

maria (customer): header: session_id,usage_tokens,utc_ts. sample: 
`abcd1234,120,2025-09-02T23:58:00Z`
`efgh5678,250,2025-09-03T00:02:00Z`
I exported from Console -> Billing -> Export CSV (Daily).

tina (support): thanks. dashboard shows day-breakdown per org tz (America/Los_Angeles) — exports should mirror that but maybe export job is using server UTC. tagging @sam for data-engineering.

sam (data-eng): looking. The export lambda reads usage rows and groups by date with `DATE_TRUNC('day', event_ts)` — that DB session default timezone is UTC on the export host. dashboard aggregation uses org_tz and does `AT TIME ZONE`. probable mismatch.

alex (eng): oh — so two different code paths. export job does not apply org timezone. that would cause rows near midnight to move between days.

maria (customer): is there a quick workaround? we need correct daily totals for invoicing today.

sam (data-eng): temporary workaround: when you open the CSV you can convert utc_ts to America/Los_Angeles in Excel/Sheets and recompute day. i'll provide a SQL patch for our side.

sam (data-eng): repro steps for us:
1) set org tz = 'America/Los_Angeles' in test org
2) create two usage events at 2025-09-02T23:58:00Z and 2025-09-03T00:02:00Z
3) run export job: `python export_daily.py --date 2025-09-03 --org 523`
4) compare output grouping with dashboard daily_breakdown endpoint: `GET /v1/orgs/523/metrics/daily?tz=America/Los_Angeles&date=2025-09-03`
expected: both rows grouped into 2025-09-02 local; actual: split across 2025-09-02 and 2025-09-03.

alex (eng): patch plan: update export to compute local_date = (event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE org_tz OR use `event_ts AT TIME ZONE org_tz` when grouping. also add regression test.

tina (support): ETA? customer needs corrected export today if possible.

alex (eng): can do hotfix: build small data-transform job that re-runs grouping with org tz and emits corrected CSV. 2-3 hours to run and QA. i'll kick it off if customer confirms they'd like that.

maria (customer): yes please. corrected CSV or corrected totals will do. thanks.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: export-tz-hotfix -> staging at 2025-09-03T14:12:00Z

sam (data-eng): followups: add a config test ensuring export and dashboard aggregation share timezone logic; add an integration test that seeds events around midnight for several org tzs (America/Los_Angeles, Asia/Kolkata).

alex (eng): noted. i'll create a PR with the fix + tests and ping for review. recording incident for postmortem if this affects billing customers.

tina (support): thanks everyone — Maria I'll DM you once we have the corrected CSV ready and attach the job log. :thumbsup:
